title: Josiah knows about Max's nap and the 'First Fruits' chapter

tellings.quote: writes the next day you know I hope your nap was nice

plain: A boy named Josiah, one of the children said in the documentary The Telepathy Tapes to read minds, knew things about a writer named Max Davis that he had no ordinary way of knowing: the day after Davis took a nap, Josiah wrote to him "I hope your nap was nice", and he also knew about a chapter of Davis's called "First Fruits". The filmmaker Ky Dickens tells this, passing on what was told to her. If true, it would point to a child picking up someone's thoughts or doings from a distance.
